mapper.insert: insert into reservation (item_id, buyer_id, expect_time, remark, status) values (#{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{expectTime}, #{remark}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: select r.*, i.title as itemTitle, i.seller_id as sellerId, u.nickname as buyerNickname from reservation r left join item i on r.item_id = i.id left join `user` u on r.buyer_id = u.id where r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update reservation set status = #{status}, handled_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from reservation where item_id = #{itemId} and status = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.update: update reservation set status = 'CLOSED', handled_at = now() where item_id = #{itemId} and status in ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
update reservation set status = 'CLOSED', handled_at = now() where item_id = #{itemId} and id != #{exceptId} and status in ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
